headline: Island Fronts Flurry As Inland Corridors Suffer Brutal Casualties
war_summary: Island fighting in Fishermans Row has intensified into a furious round of base exchanges, with Peripti Landing and Arcadia seeing rapid turnovers within the past two hours. Along the central front, Callahan's Passage has erupted into massive, accelerating bloodshed as engagements over The Latch and The Procession drive severe losses for both armies. Steady clashes continue across the Dead Lands, where Callahan's Boot and Iron's End remain contested, while the frozen battleground of Weathered Expanse sustains high casualties and fresh back-and-forth captures at Necropolis and Spirit Watch. Further east, Stlican Shelf and Marban Hollow maintain ongoing friction with recurrent skirmishes over The Old Mourn and Mox, the latter seeing renewed ownership changes right up to the hour. Conversely, Godcrofts has paused its earlier island swings with no fresh events over the last two hours, and heavy fighting in Stonecradle and Loch Mor persists primarily as bloody attritional gridlock without recent territorial shifts.
